verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own docs state that BugSnag On-premise is a self-hosted version of the product for organizations that want to manage their own data, and that it can run in existing PCI or HIPAA compliant environments. That directly covers self-hosting the core product. The evidence is a single overview statement, so depth and access terms are unproven. Missing for 10: installation and deployment documentation, plan or licensing requirements for on-premise, feature parity with the cloud version, independent or hands-on corroboration.
